request.notes: Resubmission of r4-bias-002 (cancelled 20 min in: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY loading executables from the second config on). Cause: in JAX 0.12 a jitted function that closes over a device array embeds it as a constant, so every training/validation/encoding executable carried its own copy of the 5 GB level-0 data (also the 50-60 s first-chunk compiles). Now the data are passed as arguments (checked: no large constant in the lowered HLO), compiled functions and JAX caches are released after every config, and widths 2 and 4 are ordered so N8, N0, U and the L arm run before N4/N16. The val nan of rand8_* was by design (untrained baselines; now logged as such). Training stops starting configs 2.5 h after job start, certification 2.75 h. CPU smoke test passed: job.sh end to end at tiny size (B4_TINY=1).
request.purpose: Round-4 study bias (track 1): learned level 1 from raw gliders level 0, grid of encoder locality x latent width x objective (recon, closure, local law, predictive bottleneck), 2 seeds, certified by learned_phi2's fixed family
request.setup:
curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH
uv venv -q -p 3.12 $GPUJOB_DIR/.venv && . $GPUJOB_DIR/.venv/bin/activate
uv pip install -q 'jax[cuda12]==0.12.0.1' numpy==2.5.4 scipy==1.18.0
